note: The booth sits inside a cafe that already plays music. A continuous booth loop means two playlists fighting in one room, and the booth loses. These are scoped to bounded moments — see README.

attract.label: Attract loop
attract.hook: the idle screen only, ducked to about -30 LUFS, off entirely after cafe close
attract.prompt: sparse warm loop for an empty photo booth, soft nylon guitar arpeggio, muted rhodes pads, brushed light percussion, no melody hook, no vocals, unobtrusive, loops seamlessly, 78 bpm, major key, gentle and inviting

shoot.label: Shoot bed
shoot.hook: startShoot() to the fourth shutter — roughly 16 s, bounded, the one moment the booth earns the right to be louder than the room
shoot.prompt: bright bouncy K-pop photo booth backing track, clean funk guitar skank, punchy synth bass, handclaps, light four-on-the-floor, playful and building, no vocals, 112 bpm, ends on a clean resolved chord

shoot_alt.label: Shoot bed, softer
shoot_alt.hook: same slot, for a quieter room or a cafe that finds the K-pop bed too much
shoot_alt.prompt: warm retro city pop instrumental, mellow electric piano, soft slap bass, brushed drums, breezy and unhurried, no vocals, 100 bpm, tropical and relaxed, resolves cleanly at the end
